note: Simner et al., ESOP 2022, Sec. 6 (metatheorems 1–2): for programs with stable, injectively-mapped address spaces the relaxed virtual-memory model collapses exactly to the base Armv8-A user-mode concurrency model. The model is built as an extension of that base model; outside this fragment (translation-table manipulation, TLBI) it admits additional executions not expressible in base ARMv8, so the equivalence is fragment-restricted to static/injective mappings.
